summary: MDA Space Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on the TSX and SEC-registered, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its interim condensed consolidated financial statements, MD&A and CEO/CFO certifications for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus a November 5, 2026 press release. Results show Q3 revenue of C$498.1M versus C$409.8M, nine-month revenue of C$1,460.8M, net income of C$30.9M (C$0.19 basic EPS), and cash of C$2,153.8M. No transaction, corporate action, or special-situation event is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary quarterly reporting package with no deal terms to watch.
